llms.summary: Pithyx is a free, self-hosted NAS and server OS with a web desktop: Debian 13, a C# daemon, a React desktop and apps as containers. It runs 100 percent locally, without telemetry or cloud accounts.
llms.usage: Every page below is plain Markdown. Fetch only the page you need; for a whole area take its bundle, and for everything at once {full}. Pages marked "Status: placeholder" or "Status: draft" are not checked against the code yet.
llms.everything: All pages of every area and the FAQ in one file.
llms.faq: Every frequently asked question with its answer.
reference.sdk.app.title: SDK: app and connection
reference.sdk.app.description: connect(), the PithyxApp object with every method, the formatters, the transports and the manifest types.
reference.sdk.app.intro: An app calls `connect()` once and works with the returned `PithyxApp` from then on. This page lists that object with every method, the permission each needs and the error codes it rejects with, plus the protocol messages, the formatters and the manifest types.
reference.sdk.files.title: SDK: files and storage
reference.sdk.files.description: The types of the file API: handed-over files, shares, folder pages, jobs, the recycle bin, versions and storage requests.
reference.sdk.files.intro: The methods are on `app.files`, `app.trash` and `app.jobs` (see [app and connection](/docs/reference/sdk/app/)); this page has the types they take and return. Paths are relative to a location with `/` as separator; an app never sees a path on the host.
reference.sdk.backend.title: SDK: backend
reference.sdk.backend.description: The types around app.backend: status, tokens, tickets and the backend part of the manifest.
reference.sdk.backend.intro: The methods are on `app.backend` (see [app and connection](/docs/reference/sdk/app/)); routes and headers are on [Backends](/docs/developers/apps/backend/). This page has the backend's status, its tokens and tickets, and the manifest's backend section.
reference.sdk.events-context.title: SDK: events and context
reference.sdk.events-context.description: app.context, every event of app.on and every question of app.answer, with their data.
reference.sdk.events-context.intro: `app.context` is what the desktop told the app at start, kept current by the events. `app.on(event, handler)` listens to an event and `app.answer(query, handler)` answers a question of the desktop.
reference.sdk.i18n.title: SDK: i18n
reference.sdk.i18n.description: @pithyx/sdk/i18n: createI18n for texts as ICU MessageFormat JSON in the user language.
reference.sdk.i18n.intro: `@pithyx/sdk/i18n` is an optional helper for apps that keep their texts as ICU MessageFormat JSON, the format the desktop uses. Apps may use any other i18n library; the SDK only hands them the locale.
reference.sdk.theme.title: SDK: theme
reference.sdk.theme.description: The public --pithyx-* CSS custom properties and how the SDK applies the desktop theme.
reference.sdk.theme.intro: The SDK sets the desktop look on the app document as `--pithyx-*` CSS custom properties and follows `themeChange`. The components of `@pithyx/ui` read the [tokens](/docs/reference/sdk/ui/tokens/) instead.
reference.sdk.host.title: SDK: host
reference.sdk.host.description: @pithyx/sdk/host: the desktop's side of the protocol, which serves an app window.
reference.sdk.host.intro: `@pithyx/sdk/host` is the desktop's side of the protocol: it serves one app window over a transport end, checks every call's parameters and the app's permissions, and sends events and questions. Apps do not use it; `pithyx dev` and the desktop do.
reference.sdk.errors.title: SDK: errors
reference.sdk.errors.description: PithyxError, the problem shape and the SDK transport error codes.
reference.sdk.errors.intro: Every failed call rejects with a `PithyxError`. Daemon problems pass through unchanged; the `sdk.*` codes come from the connection between app and desktop. Every code is in the [error reference](/docs/reference/errors/).

reference.index.title: SDK and UI API reference
reference.index.description: The generated API reference of @pithyx/sdk and @pithyx/ui, one page per module and per component.
reference.index.intro: The reference is generated from the TSDoc comments of the packages at build time, through their public entry points only. Guides are on [@pithyx/sdk](/docs/sdk/sdk/) and [@pithyx/ui](/docs/sdk/ui/); every error code is in the [error reference](/docs/reference/errors/).
reference.ui.tokens.title: UI: tokens
reference.ui.tokens.description: Every design token of @pithyx/ui/tokens.css with its value, the accent presets and the media overrides.
reference.ui.tokens.intro: `@pithyx/ui/tokens.css` is the only token file of Pithyx and needs no JavaScript. Colors use `light-dark()`: the theme follows the system unless `<html data-theme="light">` or `"dark"` forces one, and `<html data-accent="...">` picks an accent preset. The components read these tokens; the SDK hands apps the `--pithyx-*` properties of the [theme](/docs/reference/sdk/theme/) instead.
reference.tokens.accentsIntro: `petrol` is the default and also applies without `data-accent`. Every preset keeps AA contrast in both themes.

reference.api.index.title: REST API reference
reference.api.index.description: Every endpoint of the daemon's REST API, one page per area, generated from its OpenAPI document.
reference.api.index.intro: These pages list all {operations} operations of the daemon's REST API (version {version}), generated at build time from `packages/api-client/openapi.json`, which the daemon generates from its code; a running box serves the same document at `/api/openapi.json`. Every endpoint not described as anonymous needs the session cookie, and every write the header `X-Pithyx-Request: 1`. The document does not describe the WebSocket at `/ws`, WebDAV at `/webdav/`, or the app frontends and proxy under `/apps/<id>/`; the conventions, the WebSocket protocol and the topic list are on [API](/docs/developers/daemon/api/).

reference.api.tag.intro: Generated from the daemon's OpenAPI document. Conventions, sign-in, the CSRF header and the WebSocket are on [API]({link}).
reference.api.schemas.title: REST API: schemas
reference.api.schemas.description: Every request and response schema of the REST API with its fields.
reference.api.schemas.intro: The schemas of the daemon's OpenAPI document, sorted by name. The TypeScript types of `@pithyx/api-client` are generated from the same document.
reference.api.problem: Any failure answers with problem details (`application/problem+json`) and a stable code from the [error reference]({link}).
